welcome.title: 👋 Hi, I'm {{assistant}}!
welcome.text: Great to have you here. Shall I quickly show you how everything works — or would you like to tell me first what you want to use {{product}} for?

device-setup.title: 📱 {{assistant}} on the go
device-setup.text: Shall I show you how to get {{product}} on your phone? Then my messages reach you even when you're not at your computer.

files-tour.title: 📁 Your files
files-tour.text: Would you like to get to know the Files app next? It takes a minute.

fotos-tour.title: 📸 Your photos
fotos-tour.text: Shall I show you the Photos app — including the trick for how I build albums for you?

feedback-after-tour.title: 💬 How's it going with {{product}}?
feedback-after-tour.text: Would you briefly tell us what works well and what could be better? Your feedback comes straight to us.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{product}}! 👋
welcome.content:
Great to have you here. In a short tour I'll show you the most important areas — it takes less than two minutes.

You can ask a question below at any time or end the tour with ✕.

clara.title: This is {{assistant}}
clara.content: The most important button in {{product}}: it opens the start menu. There you'll find all apps — and {{assistant}}, your assistant who helps you with everything.

search.title: Search — or just ask
search.content: Start typing here: an app name launches the app. {{assistant}} answers everything else directly — for example “How do I add photos?” or “Make me a shopping list”.

apps.title: Your apps
apps.content: The most important apps at a glance. A click opens them in their own window — just like on a real computer.

taskbar.title: Quick access in the taskbar
taskbar.content: Your favorite apps are also pinned to the taskbar at the bottom. A small dot marks apps that are open.

tray.title: Notifications & settings
tray.content: On the right you'll find the bell for notifications, the gear for quick settings (e.g. volume, do not disturb) and the clock with the calendar.

voice.title: Talk to {{assistant}}
voice.content: Don't feel like typing? Use the microphone button to talk to {{assistant}} directly.

done.title: That's it! 🎉
done.content: You now know the basics. Just try things out — you can't break anything. And if you get stuck: ask {{assistant}}, that's what she's there for.

intro.title: Your files 📁
intro.content: Let me briefly show you the Files app — this is where your documents, photos and downloads live. I'll open it for you right away.

places.title: Your places
places.content: On the left you choose where you are: your own files, the family storage or other sources. One click switches the place.

content.title: Folders & files
content.content: This is where you see the contents. Double-click opens, right-click shows all options (share, rename, delete). To upload, simply drag files in here.

search.title: Search instead of clicking
search.content: Typing filters the current folder, Enter also searches all subfolders — handy when you no longer remember where something is.

newFolder.title: Keep things tidy
newFolder.content: Use this button to create a new folder.

done.title: That was Files! ✅
done.content: By the way: you can also simply ask me to find or tidy up files — say e.g. “{{assistant}}, find my tax documents”.

intro.title: Your photos 📸
intro.content: Let me show you the Photos app — this is where all your family photos live, safely at home with you. I'll open it right away.

app.title: The Photos app
app.content: This is your photo hub: all pictures in one timeline, automatically sorted by people and places. Photos from your phone back themselves up here.

timeline.title: The timeline
timeline.content: Under “Photos” you see all shots in chronological order — just scroll, like in the gallery on your phone.

albums.title: Albums
albums.content: Under “Albums” you collect pictures for occasions — holidays, birthdays, whatever you like.

tip.title: My tip 💡
tip.content: You don't have to put albums together yourself: just tell me “Make an album with the photos from last weekend” — I'll take care of it and show you the result.

geraete-setup.name: Set up {{assistant}} for on the go

intro.title: {{assistant}} everywhere 📱
intro.content: So far you can only reach {{product}} here in the browser. I'll show you how to get it on your phone — then my messages reach you on the go too.

push.title: Everything for your phone
push.content: This is your personal setup corner: scan the QR code with your phone camera and follow the steps — {{product}} lands as an app on your home screen, with notifications included.

computer.title: And on the computer? 💻
computer.content:
For PCs and laptops there is the {{product}} Companion app — just ask me about it if you'd like it.

As soon as your phone is set up, let me know — then I'll test whether my messages arrive.
